items.prompt:
An appeal to logic and evidence is called:
A) logos
B) pathos
C) ethos

The reason an author writes a text is their:
A) purpose
B) page count
C) font

'How something is said' is a text's:
A) style
B) page number
C) margin

A speech builds through long, swelling sentences to one short, blunt final one. This style:
A) delivers a powerful, memorable punch
B) hides the point
C) adds statistics
items.answer: A) delivers a powerful, memorable punch

solution.answer: A) delivers a powerful, memorable punch

items.prompt:
An essay pairs cool statistics with one unforgettable human image. Together, style and content:
A) make it both convincing and moving
B) cancel out
C) have no effect
items.answer: A) make it both convincing and moving

steps: Content convinces, style moves. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) make it both convincing and moving

items.prompt:
Why does HOW something is said matter in powerful rhetoric?
A) style shapes the message's power, persuasiveness, and beauty
B) only the facts matter
C) it never matters
items.answer: A) style shapes the message's power, persuasiveness, and beauty

steps: Style shapes impact. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) style shapes the message's power, persuasiveness, and beauty

items.prompt:
A speech opens each paragraph with 'Let us...' and closes on a single word: 'Now.' The style contributes to its power mainly through:
A) repetition that builds momentum and a final one-word emphasis
B) a dry statistic
C) a change of topic
items.answer: A) repetition that builds momentum and a final one-word emphasis

steps: Repetition + emphasis = power. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) repetition that builds momentum and a final one-word emphasis

items.prompt:
To analyze an author's EFFECTIVE rhetoric, you examine how:
A) style and content together create the text's power, persuasiveness, or beauty
B) long the text is
C) old the author is
items.answer: A) style and content together create the text's power, persuasiveness, or beauty

steps: Style + content = effect. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) style and content together create the text's power, persuasiveness, or beauty
